source.name: London City Lionesses, official announcement
source.note: The club's own announcement of the front-of-shirt deal. No sleeve, back or shorts sponsor is announced anywhere by the club or named press.
source.quote: today announce a landmark multi-year front-of-shirt partnership with Nike

source.name: London City Lionesses, official announcement
source.note: Nike is the club's kit supplier; the announcement confirms an existing technical partnership, extended by four years from 2027-28.
source.quote: London City and Nike have also agreed to a four-year extension of their existing technical partnership

source.name: London City Lionesses, official announcement
source.note: Official club partner and naming partner of the Sister Clubs programme; no shirt placement is stated in the announcement.
source.quote: As an official partner of our club, Mastercard will offer cardholders and our supporters a range of Priceless Experiences

summary: Nike put its swoosh on the front of the London City Lionesses shirt in what owner Michele Kang calls a record women's shirt deal. Mastercard is an official club partner, off the shirt.

change.text: New to the WSL: promoted as WSL2 champions with Nike on the front
